+"""Rainbow screen kit - preview verdict + contact sheet (round 45), run by preview.cjs after it has captured the stills.
+Per still: hole pixels (pure green sentinel background showing through the world), Benny inside the frame, Benny's size on screen vs the picture
+view, camera clearance (clipping), water gap under Benny (floating), colour look vs the approved picture (hue / saturation histogram
+correlation below the HUD), plus the measured likeness at the picture view(s) (compare_screen.py, unchanged 20-level threshold).
+  python3 -I tools/screenkit/preview_sheet.py <preview dir> <NN|-> <area|-> <game folder>
+Writes preview.json (frames + verdict) and preview_sheet.jpg (rows = places along the level, columns = left / centre / right lanes + gray)."""
+import sys, os, json, subprocess
+import numpy as np, cv2
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..'))
+out, NN, area, game = sys.argv[1:5]; raw = json.load(open(os.path.join(out, 'preview_raw.json'))); W, H = 412, 915
+if NN == '-' and area != '-': NN = area if area.isdigit() else '-'
+ref = None
+if NN != '-':
+    rp = json.load(open(os.path.join(REPO, '.claude/skills/rainbow-screen-builder/screens.json')))['screens'][NN]['reference']
+    im = Image.open(os.path.join(REPO, rp)).convert('RGB'); s = H / im.height; im = im.resize((round(im.width * s), H), Image.LANCZOS); x = (im.width - W) // 2
+    ref = np.asarray(im.crop((x, 0, x + W, H)))
+def hs_hist(a):
+    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(a[110:], cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV); h = cv2.calcHist([hsv], [0, 1], None, [36, 16], [0, 180, 0, 256]); return cv2.normalize(h, h).flatten()
+ref_h = hs_hist(ref) if ref is not None else None
+pic_h = None
+for f in raw['frames']:
+    a = np.asarray(Image.open(os.path.join(out, f['file'])).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
+    f['holes_px'] = int(((a[..., 1] > 200) & (a[..., 0] < 70) & (a[..., 2] < 70)).sum())
+    b = f['box']; f['benny_in_frame'] = bool(b['x0'] >= 0 and b['x1'] <= W and b['y0'] >= 0 and b['y1'] <= H); f['benny_h_px'] = round(b['y1'] - b['y0'], 1)
+    if f['mode'] == 'textured' and ref_h is not None: f['colour_look'] = round(float(cv2.compareHist(ref_h, hs_hist(a.astype(np.uint8)), cv2.HISTCMP_CORREL)), 3)
+    if f['tag'] == 'picture' and f['mode'] == 'textured' and pic_h is None: pic_h = f['benny_h_px']
+for f in raw['frames']:
+    if pic_h: f['benny_size_vs_picture'] = round(f['benny_h_px'] / pic_h, 3)
+# likeness at the picture view(s)
+mask = next((p for p in [os.path.join(game, 'mask_0.png'), os.path.join(game, f'a{area}', 'mask_0.png')] if os.path.exists(p)), None)
+likeness = []
+for f in raw['frames']:
+    if f['tag'] == 'picture' and f['mode'] == 'textured' and mask and NN != '-':
+        r = subprocess.run(['python3', '-I', os.path.join(HERE, 'compare_screen.py'), NN, os.path.join(out, f['file']), mask, os.path.join(out, 'compare'), '--tag', f['file'][:-4]], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+        try: d = json.loads(r.stdout); f['likeness'] = d['new']; likeness.append({'file': f['file'], **d['new']})
+        except Exception: f['likeness'] = None
+# verdict
+issues = []
+for f in raw['frames']:
+    q = f.get('qa') or {}; tag = f"{f['mode']} {f['tag']} lane {f['lane']} (s {f['s']})"
+    if f['holes_px'] > 40: issues.append(['FAIL', tag, f"{f['holes_px']} hole pixels (green)"])
+    if not f['benny_in_frame']: issues.append(['FAIL', tag, f"Benny outside the frame {f['box']}"])
+    if q.get('camClear') is not None and q['camClear'] < 0.04: issues.append(['FAIL', tag, f"camera {q['camClear']} u from scenery (clipping)"])
+    elif q.get('camClear') is not None and q['camClear'] < 0.1: issues.append(['WARN', tag, f"camera only {q['camClear']} u from scenery"])
+    if f['mode'] == 'textured' and q.get('waterGap') is None: issues.append(['FAIL', tag, 'no water mesh under Benny'])
+    elif f['mode'] == 'textured' and abs(q.get('waterGap') or 0) > 0.04: issues.append(['WARN', tag, f"water gap {q['waterGap']} u under Benny"])
+    if f.get('benny_size_vs_picture') and not 0.8 <= f['benny_size_vs_picture'] <= 1.25: issues.append(['WARN', tag, f"Benny's size on screen x{f['benny_size_vs_picture']} vs the picture view"])
+    if f.get('colour_look') is not None and f['colour_look'] < 0.6: issues.append(['WARN', tag, f"colour look {f['colour_look']} vs the approved picture"])
+verdict = 'FAIL' if any(i[0] == 'FAIL' for i in issues) else 'WARN' if issues else 'PASS'
+looks = [f['colour_look'] for f in raw['frames'] if f.get('colour_look') is not None]
+summary = {'verdict': verdict, 'issues': issues, 'likeness_picture_view': likeness, 'colour_look_min': min(looks) if looks else None,
+           'colour_look_mean': round(float(np.mean(looks)), 3) if looks else None, 'holes_total': sum(f['holes_px'] for f in raw['frames']), 'frames': len(raw['frames']),
+           'seconds': raw.get('seconds'), 'errors': raw.get('errors')}

content.text: Found it: three.js clears the target on every render call, so only the last fused piece survived. That's why the wall and water templates came out empty. Fixing:

input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tools/screenkit/bake.js'; s=open(p).read()
a="""      const rt = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(bw, bh, { depthBuffer: true }); renderer.setRenderTarget(rt); renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); renderer.clear(true, true, true);"""
b="""      const rt = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(bw, bh, { depthBuffer: true }); renderer.setRenderTarget(rt); renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0); renderer.clear(true, true, true);
      const ac = renderer.autoClear; renderer.autoClear = false;   // every draw ADDS to the template (the depth test keeps the best sample)"""
assert s.count(a)==1; s=s.replace(a,b)
a="""      renderer.setRenderTarget(null); const px = new Uint8Array(bw * bh * 4); renderer.readRenderTargetPixels(rt, 0, 0, bw, bh, px); rt.dispose(); return px; };"""
b="""      renderer.autoClear = ac; renderer.setRenderTarget(null); const px = new Uint8Array(bw * bh * 4); renderer.readRenderTargetPixels(rt, 0, 0, bw, bh, px); rt.dispose(); return px; };"""
assert s.count(a)==1; s=s.replace(a,b); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

"""Round 40: free 'clean plate' of an approved picture for the bake (no AI, no credits): the areas the game draws itself (mask: HUD, Benny,
splash, coins, socks, loose bubbles, buttons) are filled from their own surroundings (OpenCV Telea inpainting: a quarter-size pass for big
holes + a full-size pass for small ones, blended by distance into the hole). The plate is only a bake SOURCE: inside the mask the bake
gives it a reduced weight, outside the mask the bake uses the untouched picture pixels.
  python3 -I tools/reflock/plate.py <picture> <mask.png (white = fill)> <out.png>"""
import sys, numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert('RGB')); H, W = im.shape[:2]
m = (np.array(Image.open(sys.argv[2]).convert('L').resize((W, H), Image.NEAREST)) > 127).astype(np.uint8)
small = cv2.resize(im, (W // 4, H // 4), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA); ms = cv2.resize(m * 255, (W // 4, H // 4), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
fill = cv2.resize(cv2.inpaint(small, cv2.dilate(ms, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8)), 6, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA), (W, H), interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
fine = cv2.inpaint(im, m * 255, 5, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
k = np.clip(cv2.distanceTransform(m, cv2.DIST_L2, 5) / 14.0, 0, 1)[..., None]
out = im.copy(); sel = m > 0; out[sel] = (fine * (1 - k) + fill * k)[sel].astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(out).save(sys.argv[3]); print('plate', sys.argv[3], 'filled share', round(float(m.mean()), 3))

"""Rainbow screen kit (round 45) - CLONE FILL for the small holes of a clean plate (the painted coins and loose bubbles the game draws itself).
The Telea fill (tools/reflock/plate.py, unchanged) smears a hole into a soft blob of the surrounding colours; once baked, those blobs showed
as round "ghost" discs on the river while Benny swims. Here every small hole is re-filled from the best-matching patch of the SAME painting
nearby (the ring of pixels around the hole compared at 48 candidate offsets; the source must contain no masked pixel), pasted with
Poisson blending (OpenCV seamlessClone), so the streaks, sparkles and colours continue through the hole. Large holes (Benny) keep Telea.
  python3 -I tools/screenkit/plate_clone.py <picture> <mask.png> <plate.png in/out> [--max-area 14000] [--top 190]"""
import sys, argparse, numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('picture'); ap.add_argument('mask'); ap.add_argument('plate'); ap.add_argument('--max-area', type=int, default=14000); ap.add_argument('--top', type=int, default=190)
a = ap.parse_args()
im = np.array(Image.open(a.picture).convert('RGB')); H, W = im.shape[:2]
m = (np.array(Image.open(a.mask).convert('L').resize((W, H), Image.NEAREST)) > 127).astype(np.uint8)
plate = np.array(Image.open(a.plate).convert('RGB'))
n, lab, st, cen = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m, 8); done = 0
for i in range(1, n):
    x, y, w, h, area = st[i]
    if area > a.max_area or y < a.top: continue
    r = max(w, h); b = max(5, r // 4)
    comp = (lab == i).astype(np.uint8); dil = cv2.dilate(comp, np.ones((2 * b + 1, 2 * b + 1), np.uint8)); ring = (dil > 0) & (comp == 0) & (m == 0)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = max(0, x - b), max(0, y - b), min(W, x + w + b), min(H, y + h + b)
    tgt = im[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(np.float32); rg = ring[y0:y1, x0:x1]; best = None
    for k in (1.2, 1.6, 2.2):
        for t in np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 16, endpoint=False):
            dx, dy = int(round(np.cos(t) * k * r)), int(round(np.sin(t) * k * r)); sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1 = x0 + dx, y0 + dy, x1 + dx, y1 + dy
            if sx0 < 0 or sy0 < a.top or sx1 > W or sy1 > H: continue
            if m[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1][dil[y0:y1, x0:x1] > 0].any(): continue
            src = im[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1].astype(np.float32); c = float(((src - tgt) ** 2)[rg].mean()) if rg.any() else 0.0
            if best is None or c < best[0]: best = (c, dx, dy)
    if best is None: continue
    _, dx, dy = best; src = plate.copy(); src[y0:y1, x0:x1] = im[y0 + dy:y1 + dy, x0 + dx:x1 + dx]
    cm = (cv2.dilate(comp, np.ones((5, 5), np.uint8)) * 255)
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(cm); cx, cy = int((xs.min() + xs.max()) // 2), int((ys.min() + ys.max()) // 2)
    try: plate = cv2.seamlessClone(src, plate, cm, (cx, cy), cv2.NORMAL_CLONE); done += 1
    except cv2.error: pass
Image.fromarray(plate).save(a.plate); print('clone-filled', done, 'small holes of', n - 1)

"""Rainbow screen kit (round 45) - CLONE FILL for the small holes of a clean plate (the painted coins and loose bubbles the game draws itself).
The Telea fill (tools/reflock/plate.py, unchanged) smears a hole into a soft blob of the surrounding colours; once baked, those blobs showed
as round "ghost" discs on the river while Benny swims. Here every small hole is re-filled from the best-matching patch of the SAME painting
nearby (the ring of pixels around the hole compared at 48 candidate offsets; the source must contain no masked pixel), pasted with
Poisson blending (OpenCV seamlessClone), so the streaks, sparkles and colours continue through the hole. Large holes (Benny) keep Telea.
  python3 -I tools/screenkit/plate_clone.py <picture> <mask.png> <plate.png in/out> [--max-area 14000] [--top 190]"""
import sys, argparse, numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('picture'); ap.add_argument('mask'); ap.add_argument('plate'); ap.add_argument('--max-area', type=int, default=14000); ap.add_argument('--top', type=int, default=190)
a = ap.parse_args()
im = np.array(Image.open(a.picture).convert('RGB')); H, W = im.shape[:2]
m = (np.array(Image.open(a.mask).convert('L').resize((W, H), Image.NEAREST)) > 127).astype(np.uint8)
plate = np.array(Image.open(a.plate).convert('RGB'))
n, lab, st, cen = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m, 8); done = 0
for i in range(1, n):
    x, y, w, h, area = st[i]
    if area > a.max_area or y < a.top: continue
    r = max(w, h); b = max(5, r // 4)
    comp = (lab == i).astype(np.uint8); dil = cv2.dilate(comp, np.ones((2 * b + 1, 2 * b + 1), np.uint8)); ring = (dil > 0) & (comp == 0) & (m == 0)
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = max(0, x - b), max(0, y - b), min(W, x + w + b), min(H, y + h + b)
    tgt = im[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(np.float32); rg = ring[y0:y1, x0:x1]; best = None
    for k in (1.2, 1.6, 2.2):
        for t in np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 16, endpoint=False):
            dx, dy = int(round(np.cos(t) * k * r)), int(round(np.sin(t) * k * r)); sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1 = x0 + dx, y0 + dy, x1 + dx, y1 + dy
            if sx0 < 0 or sy0 < a.top or sx1 > W or sy1 > H: continue
            if m[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1][dil[y0:y1, x0:x1] > 0].any(): continue
            src = im[sy0:sy1, sx0:sx1].astype(np.float32); c = float(((src - tgt) ** 2)[rg].mean()) if rg.any() else 0.0
            if best is None or c < best[0]: best = (c, dx, dy)
    if best is None: continue
    _, dx, dy = best; src = plate.copy(); src[y0:y1, x0:x1] = im[y0 + dy:y1 + dy, x0 + dx:x1 + dx]
    cm = (cv2.dilate(comp, np.ones((5, 5), np.uint8)) * 255)
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(cm); cx, cy = int((xs.min() + xs.max()) // 2), int((ys.min() + ys.max()) // 2)
    try: plate = cv2.seamlessClone(src, plate, cm, (cx, cy), cv2.NORMAL_CLONE); done += 1
    except cv2.error: pass
Image.fromarray(plate).save(a.plate); print('clone-filled', done, 'small holes of', n - 1)

"""Rainbow ONE connected world - INCREMENTAL, CACHED builder (round 45; replaces the step list of setup_world.sh, same result folder).
Every area is built by tools/screenkit/build.py (content-addressed cache: fit, masks, Blender geometry, bake + artwork-sampled materials are
reused whenever their inputs did not change), the section (Bubble Dash -> Sock Rescue) comes pre-baked from public/section, world_layout.py
places everything on ONE route, the Blender connector pieces are cached on their spec, and the game folder is assembled. Each step is timed
(build_report.json / .md in the workspace); --preview 05,06 runs the automated preview check on those areas inside the world.
  python3 -I tools/world/build_world.py <workspace> [--preview 05,06] [--force step,..] [--quiet]
Result: <workspace>/game/play3.html (= tools/world/world.html), QA API as every kit page. Free tools only; no credits.
Areas (round 44 route 04 -> A -> B -> 05 -> 06 -> 07; each area's world settings exactly as setup_world.sh v4):
  04  tube 22 u, open end (the doorway into Bubble Dash)      05  tube 20 u, open end (runs on into the 06 drum)
  06  scaled to the world's ONE Benny (0.468 u), its far drum replaced by the join into 07       07  tube 30 u, open end, scaled
"""
import argparse, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, '..', '..'))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, 'tools', 'screenkit'))
import build as kit   # noqa: E402

AREAS = [('04', dict(tube_len=22, open_end=True)), ('05', dict(tube_len=20, open_end=True)),
         ('06', dict(benny_h=0.468, drum_far_end=True)), ('07', dict(tube_len=30, open_end=True, benny_h=0.468))]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('ws'); ap.add_argument('--preview', default=''); ap.add_argument('--force', default=''); ap.add_argument('--quiet', action='store_true')
    a = ap.parse_args(); ws = os.path.abspath(a.ws); os.makedirs(ws, exist_ok=True); G = os.path.join(ws, 'game'); force = [s for s in a.force.split(',') if s]
    B = kit.Build(ws, a.quiet, force); t0 = time.time(); area_reports = {}
    for nn, opt in AREAS:   # each area: its own cached kit build (fit -> masks -> GN geometry -> bake + templates)
        t = time.time(); rep = kit.build_screen(nn, os.path.join(ws, 's' + nn), preview=False, quiet=True, force=force, **opt)
        area_reports[nn] = rep['steps']; built = [s['step'] for s in rep['steps'] if s['status'] == 'built']
        B.steps.append({'step': f'area {nn}', 'status': ('built: ' + ', '.join(built)) if built else 'cached', 'seconds': round(time.time() - t, 2)})
        B.log(f"  area {nn}   {('built ' + ','.join(built)) if built else 'cached':40s} {time.time() - t:6.1f} s")
    def f_asm():
        if os.path.isdir(G): shutil.rmtree(G)
        os.makedirs(G)
        for nn, _ in AREAS:
            src = os.path.join(ws, 's' + nn, 'game'); d = os.path.join(G, 'a' + nn); os.makedirs(d)
            for f in ('layout.json', 'scene.glb', 'mask_0.png'): kit.place(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(d, f))
            kit.place(os.path.join(src, 'baked'), os.path.join(d, 'baked'))
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(G, 'aAB'))
        for f in ('section.json', 'section.glb'): kit.place(os.path.join(REPO, 'public', 'section', f), os.path.join(G, 'aAB', f))
        kit.place(os.path.join(REPO, 'public', 'section', 'baked'), os.path.join(G, 'aAB', 'baked'))
    B.timed('assemble', f_asm)
    out = B.timed('layout', lambda: kit.run([sys.executable, '-I', os.path.join(HERE, 'world_layout.py'), os.path.join(G, 'a04', 'layout.json'), os.path.join(G, 'aAB', 'section.json'), G,
                                             os.path.join(G, 'a05', 'layout.json'), os.path.join(G, 'a06', 'layout.json'), os.path.join(G, 'a07', 'layout.json')], log=os.path.join(ws, 'world_layout.log')))
    spec = os.path.join(G, 'connectors_spec.json')
    key = kit.h_bytes('conn-v1', kit.h_file(spec), kit.h_file(os.path.join(HERE, 'blender_connectors.py')))
    def f_conn(tmp):
        kit.run(['blender', '-b', '--factory-startup', '--python', os.path.join(HERE, 'blender_connectors.py'), '--', spec, os.path.join(tmp, 'connectors.glb')], log=os.path.join(tmp, 'connectors.log'))
    B.step('connectors', key, {'connectors.glb': os.path.join(G, 'connectors.glb')}, f_conn)
    def f_files():
        s04 = os.path.join(ws, 's04', 'game')
        for src, dst in [(os.path.join(HERE, 'world.html'), 'play3.html'), (os.path.join(REPO, 'tools/screenkit/bake.js'), 'bake.js'), (os.path.join(REPO, 'tools/kit05/controls.js'), 'controls.js'),
                         (os.path.join(REPO, 'tools/kit05/swimfx.js'), 'swimfx.js')] + [(os.path.join(s04, f), f) for f in ('benny31.glb', 'bake.png', 'coin.png', 'splash.png', 'bubble.png', 'glint.png')]:
            shutil.copyfile(os.path.realpath(src), os.path.join(G, dst))
        nm = os.path.join(G, 'node_modules')
        if os.path.lexists(nm): os.remove(nm)
        os.symlink(kit.NODE_MODULES, nm)
    B.timed('files', f_files)
    prev = {}
    for area in [s for s in a.preview.split(',') if s]:
        t = time.time(); d = os.path.join(ws, 'preview_' + area); shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
        kit.run(['node', os.path.join(REPO, 'tools/screenkit/preview.cjs'), G, d, '--screen', area, '--area', area], env={'NODE_PATH': kit.npm_root()}, log=os.path.join(ws, f'preview_{area}.log'))
        pj = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, 'preview.json'))); prev[area] = pj['summary']
        B.steps.append({'step': f'preview {area}', 'status': pj['verdict'], 'seconds': round(time.time() - t, 2)}); B.log(f"  preview {area} {pj['verdict']:8s} {time.time() - t:6.1f} s")
    rep = B.report({'areas': area_reports, 'preview': prev})
    print(f"world ready: {os.path.join(G, 'play3.html')}  ({rep['total_seconds']} s; report {os.path.join(ws, 'build_report.md')})")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

content.text:
Yes. There is a way to measure it while Benny swims, and I can add it to the automatic checks. Here's how it works.

**Why the picture is in the game.** Your approved picture is used like paint. It is painted once onto the real 3D tunnel walls, rings, water and foam. The game is not showing your picture behind Benny. When he swims forward, he is moving through 3D shapes covered with your artwork, which is why it looks like your screen from new angles too.

**Why "exactly" isn't possible everywhere.** Your picture shows one moment from one spot. Once Benny swims on, the camera sees parts your picture never showed, like the walls beside him or the tunnel past a turn. Nobody can compare pixel-for-pixel there, because your picture has no pixels for those places. What can be measured is whether the scenery keeps the same design everywhere: same walls, gold rings, water, foam and colours.

**Three numbers on every check from now on:**
1. **At your approved camera:** the percentage I've been reporting (05 is at 81.7 %, 06 at 84.4 %).
2. **Repeated along the level:** your tunnel repeats ring after ring. At each ring further down the level, I put the camera in the same position relative to the scenery as in your picture. Then I score that view against your approved picture with the same percentage. If the scenery really continues your design, those views should score close to number 1. If one place scores low, that's a spot where the scenery stops looking like yours, and I fix it.
3. **Each surface while swimming:** in the swimming frames, the game knows which pixels are wall, ring, water and foam. Each is compared with the same surface in your picture for colour, brightness and detail. That gives scores like "walls 90 % like your walls, water 85 %".

These numbers tell us where it falls short. The final judge is still you watching an uninterrupted recording of Benny swimming through 05 into 06. The goal for both is the same as before: about 90 % at your camera, and every place along the level close to that.

# Round 45 — resume here (2026-11-22, session branch `ccr-c1b272d2-3ru7yx`, continues round 44 `ccr-0bbd5b9d-js1cpg`)

## User orders this round (binding, verbatim essentials)
1. "Finish Screen 05 and Screen 06 properly before continuing major reconstruction work on the others" — S-river with thick cyan/pink currents,
   purple walls, gold rings, bubbles, foam; beautiful while Benny swims/turns, also outside the original picture; a real 3D tunnel.
   06: Benny genuinely on the curved water (incline + banking), partly immersed, fully visible, splash/wake on his real position, camera without
   clipping / leaning / size jumps; 05 → 06 without stopping, teleporting, page load or scale change; gray test then artwork; recordings; APK.
2. (second message, binding) "upgrade our existing Blender Screen Builder into a faster, reusable, automated reconstruction pipeline … incremental
   … cache unchanged assets and texture bakes … automate visual checks before full recordings … previews of beginning, middle, curves and end incl.
   left and right steering … show before-and-after results, the actual time spent on each reconstruction step, and continuous playable gameplay".
3. (third) "add the measurements" — a way to know the scenery matches the approved screen WHILE Benny swims (see §3), "and do the recording and APK".
4. "While I'm waiting, can you do the other screens?" -> answered: 04 + 07 are rebuilt automatically by the world builder (new materials);
   08, 09, 10 need their own fit scripts first -> NEXT after the 05/06 deliverables.

## 1. What was built (all free tools; no credits)
| file | what |
|---|---|
| `tools/screenkit/build.py` | incremental cached builder per screen: depth -> fit -> layout -> segment -> gnlib -> geometry -> assemble -> bake -> preview, each step keyed on the SHA-256 of exactly its inputs (cache `~/.cache/rainbow-build`), timed (`build_report.md`) |
| `tools/screenkit/gn_assets.py` | the Geometry Nodes ASSET LIBRARY (`rainbow_gn_assets.blend`, marked as Blender assets): RB_PerforatedDrum, RB_WaterChannel, RB_ChannelBody, RB_Band, RB_GoldRing, RB_FoamBank v2 (cumulus clusters), RB_WallTray, RB_MachineryRow |
| `tools/screenkit/blender_kit.py` | now loads the asset library; `GEOM_KEYS` = the only layout keys that re-run Blender; new keys `machinery`, `foam_style`, `foam_banks`, `foam_pool_from` |
| `tools/screenkit/bake.js` | the bake moved out of screen.html (cache key) + ARTWORK-SAMPLED MATERIALS: ring / tray templates fused from every ring / tray the picture shows (best sample per texel via depth = 1 - quality), drum-wall PERIOD template phase-locked to the rings (gold/copper gate, unseen angles + rows mirrored from painted ones), flowing water / pool / flume SWATCHES (seamless along the flow) |
| `tools/screenkit/plate_clone.py` | the small holes of the clean plate (painted coins, bubbles) clone-filled from the same painting + Poisson blend (no ghost discs); mask value 128 = trusted |
| `tools/screenkit/preview.cjs` + `preview_sheet.py` | AUTOMATED PREVIEW CHECK: picture view(s) first, begin / quarter / middle / three-quarter / sharpest curves / end x left / centre / right lanes (real swipe input), gray geometry pass, green-sentinel holes, Benny in frame + size, camera clearance, water gap, likeness, contact sheet, PASS/WARN/FAIL |
| `tools/screenkit/qa.js` | QA views: `qaRepeatView(k)` (the approved camera k ring spacings further down: scored against the picture), `qaIdPass` (which pixel is wall / ring / water / foam / trays -> per-surface colour + detail match while swimming) |
| `tools/world/build_world.py` | cached ONE-world builder (04, 05, 06, 07 via build.py; section; layout; connectors cached; files; previews) |
| `tools/world/world.html` | templates on every kit area + connectors (wall period along connector tubes, ring band, river swatch); start buttons 04 / 05 / 06 in play mode; `?return=1` hands back to the game at 08 |
| `tools/world/build_world_app.sh` + `src/game/bonusRoute.ts` (WORLD_ROUTE) + `src/game/Game.ts` | the world in the app: `VITE_RAINBOW_WORLD=1` (or `?world=1`): opening videos -> world 04 -> A -> B -> 05 -> 06 -> 07 -> game at the 08 checkpoint. Default game unchanged |
| `tools/reflock/section_run.cjs` | `FRAMEQA=1`: camera clearance, water gap, immersion, tilt, Benny size per frame in the recording checks |
Fixed on the way: Blender 5 copies a node group's inputs into the modifier when it is CREATED (the old builder's first foam bank was one lump,
the first tray / ring got the previous sizes); three.js autoClear wiped every fused draw but the last; the export's wait was commented out.

## 2. Numbers (412 x 915, scenery px within 20 levels of the approved picture; HUD / Benny / coins masked out)
| | before (r44) | now (r45) |
|---|---|---|
| 05 picture view, own page | 81.2 % (pre-baked) | 81.7 % |
| 05 picture view, in the world | 80.6 % | 80.7 % |
| 06 picture view, in the world (scaled) | 82.0 % | 85.0 % |
While swimming (round 45 metrics, world, 18 stills each): surface style match 05 walls 84.7 / rings 63.3 / water 53.3 / foam 19.3 / trays 93.5;
06 walls 87.5 / rings 55.3 / water 55.3 / foam 19.9 / trays 94.2. Repeated approved camera (k = 1..12 rings further): 05 mean 23 %, 06 mean 16 %
(the water dominates: the river beyond the painted stretch is not the painted S yet). Holes: 05 5 px in one still, 06 0.
Build time: old method per rebuild 05 29.9 s, 06 44.4 s (everything re-ran); new: cold 05 ~66 s incl. templates + preview, cached no-change < 1 s,
a look-only change re-runs nothing heavy, a bake-code change re-runs only the bakes (world: 347 s for 4 areas + 2 previews).
Evidence: `qa/kit45/` (README when written).

## 3. Next, in order
1. Finish the deliverables: recordings `qa/kit45/run/` (textured + gray, 05 -> 06, real touch), APK, before/after sheets, timing table, README.
2. In-motion look (the measured gap): water beyond the painted stretch (painted S along the whole river, pink bands), foam banks matching the painted
   foam (style 19 %), ring template detail (55-63 %); 06 crest banking / camera lean review in the recording.
3. Then 08, 09, 10 with the kit (fit scripts from their approved pictures), 07 -> 08 descent.

import json, os

def frame(d, tag, lane=0):

    B='$S/before_'+nn; A='$S/wr/preview_'+nn
    cols=[('picture',0),('quarter',0),('middle',-1),('three_q',1)]
    tw,th=260,578; o=Image.new('RGB',(40+ (len(cols)+1)*(tw+8), 2*(th+34)+40),(22,8,38)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(o)

            d.text((x+2,y+th+6),f"{lab} {tag if tag!='three_q' else 'later'}{' L'+str(lane) if lane else ''}{extra}",fill=(255,255,255),font=f)
    o.save(f'qa/kit45/BEFORE_NOW_{nn}.jpg',quality=86)
    for D,lab in ((B,'BEFORE'),(A,'NOW')):
        p=os.path.join(D,'repeat_strip.jpg')
        if os.path.exists(p): Image.open(p).save(f'qa/kit45/REPEAT_{nn}_{lab}.jpg',quality=84)
print('ok')
EOF
